abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Aethervoid Pendulum**on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up an **Aethervoid Pendulum** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
